pages.title: Temporal Freeze
pages.text: The $(b)Stasis Sword$(0) manipulates local chrono-particles.$(br2)Right-clicking manifests a shimmering stasis bubble around the target area, freezing all hostile entities and incoming projectiles dead in their tracks for several seconds.

pages.title: Tactical Mastery
pages.text: Entities suspended in stasis cannot retaliate or dodge. Use this window to reposition, recover health, or line up devastating multi-target combos before time resumes.
